items.html: And the matter is that during the three days of absorption, the correction of the fetus begins, as mentioned above, and this corresponds to the phase of pregnancy. And the matter is that already in these three days, ZA had already begun to be corrected a little, for the three were bound and included with the three and made into the manner of lines. And also, the three lower ones clothed the three upper ones, and they became one united body in a strong bond. However, all that was revealed then from ZA is nothing but its three final ones, Netzach-Hod-Yesod, as mentioned above.
